cases.problem_text:
Find the limit, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.
lim_{x→−4} (|x + 4| − 2x)
cases.lean_theorem_header: theorem absolute_limit : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => |x + 4| - 2 * x) (nhdsWithin (-4) {(-4 : ℝ)}ᶜ) (nhds (8 : ℝ)) :=
cases.proof_body:
by
  have hleft : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => |x + 4| - 2 * x)
      (nhdsWithin (-4) (Set.Iio (-4))) (nhds (8 : ℝ)) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => -3 * x - 4) (-4) := by fun_prop
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -3 * x - 4)
        (nhdsWithin (-4) (Set.Iio (-4))) (nhds (8 : ℝ)) := by
      have h := hc.tendsto.mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : nhdsWithin (-4) (Set.Iio (-4)) ≤ nhds (-4 : ℝ))
      norm_num at h
      simpa using h
    apply hlim.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    have hneg : x + 4 < 0 := by change x < -4 at hx; linarith
    rw [abs_of_neg hneg]
    ring
  have hright : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => |x + 4| - 2 * x)
      (nhdsWithin (-4) (Set.Ioi (-4))) (nhds (8 : ℝ)) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => 4 - x) (-4) := by fun_prop
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 4 - x)
        (nhdsWithin (-4) (Set.Ioi (-4))) (nhds (8 : ℝ)) := by
      have h := hc.tendsto.mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : nhdsWithin (-4) (Set.Ioi (-4)) ≤ nhds (-4 : ℝ))
      norm_num at h
      simpa using h
    apply hlim.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    have hpos : 0 ≤ x + 4 := by change -4 < x at hx; linarith
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hpos]
    ring
  rw [← nhdsLT_sup_nhdsGT]
  exact hleft.sup hright

reference.rationale: 先把左側表達式化為 −3x − 4、右側化為 4 − x，各求單側極限為 8，再由左右極限相等得到原極限。絕對值分情況與線性函數的連續性用於求各側極限，主要架構為左右極限法。

cases.proof_body:
by
  have hadd : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x + 4) (-4) :=
    continuousAt_id.add continuousAt_const
  have habs : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => |x + 4|) (-4) := hadd.abs
  have hlinear : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => 2 * x) (-4) :=
    continuousAt_id.const_mul 2
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => |x + 4| - 2 * x) (-4) :=
    habs.sub hlinear
  have hlim := hc.tendsto.mono_left
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : nhdsWithin (-4) {(-4 : ℝ)}ᶜ ≤ nhds (-4 : ℝ))
  norm_num at hlim
  exact hlim

reference.rationale: 逐步利用和、絕對值、常數倍及差的連續性，證明函數在 −4 連續，再以該點函數值求極限為 8。與全域連續證明同屬直接代入策略，逐項證明連續性不另算一種主要方法。
